optimization.reason: The obvious rewrite is a new combined tokenizer/substitution engine for percent, dollar, brace, quote, bytes, and missing-variable cases. It changes the parser rather than one local data operation, and compiling/caching it outside the region would shift measured work. No bounded differential corpus here is broad enough to justify that semantic risk.
